description: This Dart source file provides utility functions for widget testing in Flutter, specifically for unit and widget tests involving asynchronous frame pumping, conditional widget finding, unmounting widget trees, and cleanup of test dependencies like databases and mock download engines.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite package to use the FFI implementation, set up for testing environments to prevent hangs due to platform dependencies.

methods.name: pumpFrames
methods.description: Advances the widget testing environment by pumping a specified number of frames with a given duration between frames.

methods.name: assertNoScheduledFramesAfterPumps
methods.description: Pumps a fixed number of frames and asserts that no frames are scheduled afterward, ensuring no periodic timers or animations are left pending.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps frames until the framework becomes idle or a timeout is reached, with a fallback to pump extra frames, and optionally asserts no pending frames.

methods.name: pumpUntilFound
methods.description: Pumps frames until a specified widget finder matches or the timeout is reached, ensuring the widget appears.

methods.name: unmountWidgetTree
methods.description: Unmounts any existing widget tree and performs a bounded settle to ensure cleanup.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up application dependencies in tests, canceling timers and closing databases.
